info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v4-spec
info.description: The Void Payment Transaction API allows clients to cancel previously authorized payment transactions efficiently. By issuing a DELETE request to the specified endpoint, users can reverse payments that are no longer needed or were processed in error. This service is particularly valuable for merchants and payment processors looking to maintain accurate transaction records and manage customer refunds seamlessly. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and financial institutions that require reliable transaction management capabilities.

delete.description: This operation allows you to void a payment transaction that has already been processed, reversing its effect. It is important to ensure that you only void transactions that are eligible for such an action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to void a payment. You must provide the necessary details to identify the payment that needs to be voided.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: Payload for voiding a payment operation, typically used in a DELETE request.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Payment Void Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the payment transaction.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The total processing time for the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message conveying information about the void operation.

audit.description: Information about the audit of the operation.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: This schema represents the response returned after a successful payment void operation.
